title: A birational hypersurface model of the geometrically integral generic fibre
statement:
Let X and S be affine schemes [def-weil-affine-spectrum], with S integral
[def-pc-integral-scheme], and let f:X\to S be locally finitely presented
[def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Let \eta be a generic point of S. Suppose
X_\eta [def-pc-scheme-fibre] is geometrically irreducible and geometrically reduced
[def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]. Put A=\Gamma(S,\mathcal O_S). There exist n\in\mathbf N
and P\in A[t_1,\ldots,t_n] [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring] such that, for
H=\operatorname{Spec}(A[t_1,\ldots,t_n]/(P)) and g:H\to S induced by coefficient inclusion
and S\cong\operatorname{Spec}A, the generic fibre H_\eta is geometrically irreducible and
geometrically reduced, and X_\eta and H_\eta are birational over \operatorname{Spec}\kappa(\eta).
Here birational means that there exist dense open subschemes of the two generic fibres
and an isomorphism between them commuting with their maps to \operatorname{Spec}\kappa(\eta).
The common opens are asserted only on the generic fibres, not on X or H.

proof.text: Construct n,P with geometrically integral generic fibre and a fraction-ring isomorphism compatible with the residue-field base using the field-generator and denominator-clearing construction.

Install the integrality and local finite type facts. Apply the general affine fraction-ring birationality criterion to the two generic fibres and the compatible fraction-ring isomorphism; combine with the geometric properties.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_generic_fibre_birational_hypersurface_model
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] [IsAffine S] [IsIntegral S]
    (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (η : S) (hη : IsGenericPoint η Set.univ)
    (hgeom : GeometricallyIrreducible (f.fiberToSpecResidueField η))
    (hred : GeometricallyReduced (f.fiberToSpecResidueField η)) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial (Fin n) Γ(S, ⊤)),
      let H := Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin n) Γ(S, ⊤) ⧸ Ideal.span {P}))
      let g : H ⟶ S := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {P})).comp MvPolynomial.C)) ≫ S.isoSpec.inv
      GeometricallyIrreducible (g.fiberToSpecResidueField η) ∧
        GeometricallyReduced (g.fiberToSpecResidueField η) ∧
        Scheme.BirationalOver (f.fiberToSpecResidueField η)
          (g.fiberToSpecResidueField η)
